notes: Assumes the evaluator binds $min_age as INT64 and supplies the current graph as stated. The initial MATCH enumerates every player; the target age predicate remains inside OPTIONAL MATCH so no qualifying outgoing edge yields dst=NULL. RETURN without DISTINCT retains one row per matching follow edge, including parallel-edge duplicates. src/dst use the business id property. References: SKILL.md Core Generation Rules; references/patterns.md Node Pattern Filler, Filter Placement, OPTIONAL MATCH; references/query-language.md MATCH and WHERE / Filter Placement; references/checklist.md and applicable references/validation.md checks. Identifier names a, b, player, follow, age, id, src, dst, min_age were checked with the bundled quote-identifiers helper and are ordinary identifiers. No database execution was performed.
